scheduledTasks.title: Scheduled tasks
scheduledTasks.intro: At each scheduled time, ClaudeWeb opens a new conversation in the chosen project and sends the prompt. It runs on the server, so it works with the browser closed. One task runs at a time; a run missed while ClaudeWeb was stopped runs once when it starts again.
